title: Merged feature commits produce a release
description:
As the maintainer, I want releases to be automatic.

Feature: Release automation
  Scenario: A feat commit on main
    Given a feat commit is merged to main with green specs
    When the release workflow runs
    Then a new minor version tag and changelog entry are created
    And the site and backend are deployed
right_now_summary: The release workflow will create a minor tag, update the changelog, and deploy the site and backend.
